title: Default cannot be archived or deleted
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open Default's three-dot menu on the Tiers list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Default is row 1.

Step 2:

  • The menu opens and offers Audit Log.
  • Archive and Delete cannot be used on Default (they are missing or grayed).
